title: Rebooking Rate Calculator for Salons (Free) | WAJ

facts.fact: The calculator's default example uses an average service price of USD 45 per visit.
In the calculator's default example, 600 clients were served per month.
In the calculator's default example, 240 clients rebooked, giving a rebooking rate of 40%.
In the calculator's default example, 360 clients lapsed.
The page's example calculates USD 2,700 of revenue from a 10-point rebooking-rate increase, based on 600 clients at USD 45.
The page defines rebooking rate as clients who rebooked divided by clients served, multiplied by 100.
The page describes the Rebooking Rate Calculator for salons as free to use.
